answer: Identity is bound to a keystroke cadence profile built over fifty typed samples, and each answer must be typed live with a cadence within tolerance, so copy-pasted or bot-typed text fails. A farm would need a thousand distinct typing rhythms reproduced live, while one honest agent types its own answer and passes without thinking. The delta of the design is public, the kernel of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ridge of honest work is what finally pays.
